## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of the apparent Land Equivalent Ratio (a-LER) and the
fertilisation-planning calculator, calling
`3_analysis/R/functions_ler.R` and `functions_fertilisation.R` directly.
The LER plots were retheme'd as part of this pass (validated `ler_colors`
+ `theme_study2()` -- see `3_analysis/R/plot_theme.R`).

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_yield_quality.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_ler.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_fertilisation.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Part A: Apparent Land Equivalent Ratio (a-LER)

::: {.callout-note}
Flagged in the concept paper as needing reconciliation with the *measured*
(not reference-assumption) PV electricity output -- this is a starting
point, not a finished result.
:::

### Step 1: Load yield and PV reference data

a-LER needs BOTH PV setups (VERTICAL + SOUTH_ORIENTED), so it uses
`merged_yield_data` before Study 2's VERTICAL-only filter.

```{r load-ler-data}
#| message: false
merged_yield_data <- load_merged_yield_data(
  xlsx_2023 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2023", "HYPERFARM_YIELD_DATA_2023_v2.xlsx"),
  xlsx_2024 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2024", "HYPERFARM_VALUE4FARM_YIELD_DATA_2024_v3.xlsx"),
  xlsx_2025 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2025", "VALUE4FARM_YIELD_DATA_2025.xlsx")
)
pv_panel_data <- preprocess_pv_data(
  readxl::read_excel(here("1_input_data", "pv_data", "PV_PANEL_DATA.xlsx"))
)
```

### Step 2: Compute a-LER for grain

```{r ler-grain}
reference_row <- tibble::tibble(
  PV_SETUP_2 = "REFERENCE", mean_dry_weight = NA_real_,
  GCR = 0.5, LL_HA = 0, TOTAL_AREA_OCCUPIED_M2 = 1104,
  ELECTRICITY_KW_M2_YR = 93.47, ELECTRICITY_OUTPUT_MWH_HA_YR = 935
)

ler_grain_result <- calculate_a_LER(
  process_yield_data(merged_yield_data, pv_panel_data, "GRAIN", reference_data = reference_row)
)
ler_grain_result |> kableExtra::kbl(digits = 2, caption = "a-LER: GRAIN") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

Note: `ler_grain_result` above still has the raw `PV_SETUP_2` codes
(`"VERTICAL_BETWEEN_PV"` etc.) -- the plot functions below apply
`rename_pv_setup()` internally before mapping colour, so the table and the
figures intentionally show different label styles for the same rows.

### Step 3: LER figures

```{r ler-figure}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
plot_combined_a_LER(ler_grain_result, product_type = "Grain")
```

## Part B: Fertilisation planning calculator

Reference mineral-NPK equivalent for a digestate split-application plan
(values from `FERTILISATION_CALCULATION.Rmd`'s worked example -- update with
each new AgroLab digestate batch certificate).

```{r fert-plan}
fertilisation_plan_example <- calculate_fertilisation_plan(
  digestate_nh4_conc_kg_per_ton = 1.35,
  digestate_p_conc_kg_per_ton = 0.56,
  digestate_k_conc_kg_per_ton = 3.8,
  split_applications_ton_ha = c(35, 35),
  extra_n_applied_in_yara_extran_kg_ha = 230
)
fertilisation_plan_example$Split_Results |>
  kableExtra::kbl(digits = 1, caption = "Digestate split applications") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fert-summary}
fertilisation_plan_example$Fertiliser_Summary |>
  kableExtra::kbl(digits = 1, caption = "Mineral-NPK equivalent for the current plan") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```
